Payment Use Case

What customers pay for

Zenzy collects payments for its digital AI video creation services. Customers can purchase one-time Ruby/A-Coin credit packs or recurring Premium subscriptions. Payments are used to provision the purchased digital credits or subscription benefits inside the Zenzy application.

Digital Delivery

No physical shipping

Zenzy sells digital services and digital credits. Ruby/A-Coin credits and Premium benefits are delivered electronically to the user's Zenzy account after successful payment verification.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions.

Are Ruby Shop purchases subscriptions?

No. Ruby/A-Coin packs are one-time digital credit purchases. They are separate from Monthly and Yearly Premium subscriptions.

What is Premium?

Premium is a recurring subscription that provides the benefits shown for the selected Monthly or Yearly plan.

What happens after a successful payment?

After payment verification, eligible Ruby/A-Coin credits or Premium subscription benefits are provisioned to the user's Zenzy account.

How can I request support for a payment?

Email aikairova1@gmail.com with the transaction/reference details, amount and date of payment.
